coverage_note: IMPORTANT: slices 1-11 were needle-driven — the author migrated the strings they enumerated, and each per-screen purity test asserted only those same needles. Marker-based scans have since shown that several screens marked 'fully migrated' retained Portuguese in conditional branches, secondary buttons, footers and all-caps banners that the needles missed. Sweep A re-audited and completed the pre-auth, settings and notice screens exhaustively (marker-free scan clean). Screens still marked 'partial' above await the same exhaustive pass. A source-level CI guard that scans for chrome string literals not routed through i18n (making mixed-language detectable, not needle-dependent) is the intended permanent gate and is not yet in place.
